what_slowed_me_down: Installing @monid-ai/cli globally via `npm install -g` failed initially with EACCES on /usr/lib/node_modules as a non-root user until setting npm prefix to ~/.local.

On large responses (such as 50 keywords on dataforseo /labs/keyword-overview), `monid run -w -o <file> -j` wrote the `{ "data": { "download_link": ... } }` wrapper to `-o` rather than auto-downloading the JSON payload as described in SKILL.md, requiring an extra fetch of `download_link`.

Evaluating SERP endpoints took a few test calls: serpapi `/google/search` and dataforseo `/serp/google-organic` returned opaque `google.com/goto?url=...` redirect links (and Google's first page only had 8 organic results), whereas cloro `/google/search` with `pages: 2` returned clean destination URLs and at least 10 organic results per keyword, wrapped under `{ "success": true, "result": { "organicResults": [...] } }` (not mentioned in the inspect summary) and taking ~50 single-query runs since no batch SERP endpoint was available.
